name: jupp-stop
pronunciation_note: Wake name plus command in one phrase, so eaRS can bind it to stop while 'Hey Jupp' starts. Said with a German j (English y). Bare 'Jupp'/'yup' is a near-miss for this phrase: it needs the stop. German only (owner, 2026-11-04): nobody addresses 'Jupp' in English, so there is no English head to train, record or publish.
